title: In Defense of OCTA: The Reconstruction-Utility Gap in OCT-to-OCTA Synthesis
abstract: arXiv:2608.15626v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Optical coherence tomography angiography (OCTA) images retinal blood flow, giving capillary-perfusion and foveal-avascular-zone biomarkers that grade diabetic-retinopathy ischemia. Because OCTA hardware is less common than structural OCT, recent work synthesizes it from OCT, reporting strong reconstruction (3D PSNR > 31 dB, SSIM > 0.9). We ask not whether the synthetic image looks similar, but whether it supports the measurements OCTA is acquired for. A frozen real-OCTA segmenter, applied as a probe to two synthesizers (XOCT, TransPro), shows downstream Dice falling with structural fineness: large vessels survive (0.862 -> 0.831) while the fine capillary network collapses (0.798 -> 0.635, five times the large-vessel loss; paired Wilcoxon p < 1e-3), TransPro worse throughout. A matched-blur control shows this detail is fabricated, not blurred. Retrained on a private Spectralis dataset, neither synthesizer reproduces the neovascular lesion

translated_title: 为OCTA辩护：OCT到OCTA合成中的重建-效用差距
translated_abstract: 光学相干断层扫描血管成像（OCTA）能够显示视网膜血流，提供毛细血管灌注和黄斑无血管区等生物标志物，用于糖尿病视网膜病变缺血程度的分级。由于OCTA硬件不如结构OCT普及，近期研究尝试从OCT合成OCTA，并报告了较强的重建性能（3D PSNR > 31 dB，SSIM > 0.9）。我们关注的问题不是合成图像是否看起来相似，而是它是否能支持OCTA原本用于的测量任务。我们将一个冻结的真实OCTA分割器作为探针，应用于两种合成器（XOCT和TransPro），结果显示下游Dice指标随结构精细度下降：大血管存活（0.862降至0.831），而精细毛细血管网络崩溃（0.798降至0.635，损失为大血管的五倍；配对Wilcoxon检验p < 1e-3），TransPro在所有情况下表现更差。通过匹配模糊的对照组实验，我们证明这种细节是伪造的，而非模糊所致。在私有Spectralis数据集上重新训练后，两种合成器均无法重现新生血管病变。
tldr: 该论文指出，尽管OCT到OCTA的合成在重建指标上表现优异，但合成图像无法保留精细毛细血管细节，导致下游分割任务性能显著下降，且这些细节是伪造而非模糊的结果，表明当前合成方法存在“重建-效用差距”。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals that despite strong reconstruction metrics, synthesized OCTA from OCT fails to preserve fine capillary details, causing significant degradation in downstream segmentation tasks, and these details are fabricated rather than blurred, highlighting a reconstruction-utility gap in current synthesis methods.
